extracted.intended_audience: COLING program committee members and paper reviewers
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for reviewers evaluating submissions to the COLING conference, listing five main evaluation criteria and additional review principles about mission focus and balancing quality with breadth.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevance
rubrics_metrics.description: Is this paper relevant to COLING?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether the submission fits COLING's scope (research at the intersection of linguistics and computation). Consider alignment with the conference's mission and topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Readability/Clarity
rubrics_metrics.description: Is the paper well-written and well-structured?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check clarity of exposition, organization, and whether the paper communicates its ideas effectively to the intended audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality
rubrics_metrics.description: How original and innovative is the research described?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Originality could be in: (a) The linguistic question being addressed; (b) The methodology applied to the linguistic question; (c) The combination of the two. Evaluate novelty and contribution relative to prior work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical Correctness/Soundness
rubrics_metrics.description: Is the research described in the paper technically sound and correct?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Can one trust the claims of the paper—are they supported by the analysis or experiments and are the results correctly interpreted? Examine methodology, experimental design, statistical treatment, and the link between evidence and claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Have you personally checked the accessibility of the resource, data or code?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify that provided resources (data, code, models) are accessible, usable, and documented as claimed. Note any barriers to reproducing results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Balanced Review Approach (Key Review Principles)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewers should take a balanced approach when reviewing papers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: COLING seeks a solid technical program with high-quality papers describing complete pieces of work, but also wants a broad and interesting program—reviewers should keep an open mind when evaluating and recommending papers. Balance strict technical standards with openness to diverse, potentially high-impact or exploratory work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission Focus: intersection of linguistics and computation; analysis beyond leaderboards
rubrics_metrics.description: The mission of COLING is to present research at the intersection of linguistics and computation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select papers with in-depth analysis of results, going beyond mere figures for leaderboards. Where appropriate, prefer work that provides analysis using diagnostic datasets designed to evaluate performance with respect to motivated linguistic phenomena.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review Process: double-blind
rubrics_metrics.description: For COLING 2025, the review process is double-blind.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural note for reviewers: follow double-blind norms (do not attempt to reveal or disclose author identities; evaluate the submission on its content).
